title: Interfacial charge transfer in black carbon–mineral dust hybrids boosts atmospheric photooxidation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00566C, Paper
Jiejing Kong, Yuqing Tang, Mingzhu He, Jintao Liu, Yunlong Guo, Taicheng An
BC–TiO2 hybrids triple ·OH yields via interfacial charge transfer, sustain 53% activity at 50% RH by shielding active sites, and redirect oxidation to volatile aldehydes (>85% yield), suppressing SOA precursors.
